scope: Normal-sized crops, initial traits, no market events, reputation or negotiated price changes; does not include cultivation, equipment, or waiting-for-customers costs
advanced_seed_stock: Unlock advanced seed entries without replacing the four basic crops
income_interpretation: Use sale proceeds minus seed spending as a comparison only; it is not net profit, instant cash, or guaranteed daily sales
brewing_prices: User approved the working fermentation cycles and prices in brewing-proposal.json; whole-chain economics and customer affordability remain to be playtested
harvest_size_and_quality: User selected small/normal/large for six vegetables and fruits, occupying 1/2/4 cells. The former giant label is replaced by large, with no extra fourth tier. User approved size price multipliers 0.5/1/2.5 relative to normal-sized prices. Wheat and hops use quality rather than size grades.
crop_sales_channel: Crops are displayed to attract food buyers. There is no player eating mechanic; native food-related traits describe merchandise properties rather than player consumption.
showcase_findings: ShowcaseHelper.CreateClientByStockType chooses original buyer profiles by stock category, displayed value, station day and store attractiveness
Native wine uses SUBSTANCE and ALCOHOL; sufficiently high native wine quality also grants LUXURY_ITEM
Do not assume adding a new ingredient tag alone creates a valid original-customer sales channel; verify classifications for all crops including hops
